carbon_analogue.source: NASA NTRS 20240006219, Keller et al. (2024), preliminary Bennu carbon measurement; analogue only, not a designated source. Recovery is an engineering sensitivity, not a reported result.

platinum_sensitivity.evidence: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026: 2025 estimated platinum price 1200 USD/troy ounce, approximately 38600 USD/kg, and mine output 170000 kg. Grade and recovery trials are not asteroid assays; frozen historical price only.

coproducts.rule: Aggregate metal grades may not also be counted as separate iron, nickel or precious-metal output. Unassayed products receive no invented concentration, reserve or revenue. All residues remain controlled; release/capture chemistry and storage need process-specific verification.

economy.evidence: Capacity and supply-use scenarios, with explicit component partitions, prices and qualification gates; no adopted architecture, market forecast, automatic demographic growth or proven self-reproduction.

exports.service_portfolio: Retain the earlier reference research, media, remote-work and destination-service scenario as an explicit option, with its facilities and imports. It is not a market ceiling; passenger access requires separate qualification.

growth.industrial_stock_policy: Maintain the initial supplier-stock intensity per resident in balanced expansion; new capacity enters the next annual step. Also test fixed plant and maintenance-only rightsizing.

rules: Domestic gross output counts intermediate production; GDP/GVA subtracts domestic and imported intermediate inputs. Imports of capital enter investment and imports once; depreciation is subtracted only for net product.
Growth is domestic capital formation and increases future maintenance, resources and funding needs; it is not external revenue.
The prior 100 kg/resident export-factory constraint and customer-budget ceilings are absent from capacity calculations. Prices, demand and qualification remain independent gates.
The same spare capacity cannot simultaneously support maximum exports, replacement and maximum growth.

Component partitions and extended structural lives are design comparisons; imported active modules retain their original lives. Price-density sensitivity prevents mass localization from being treated as a guaranteed equal percentage of value localization.
Local fabrication consumes metal, alloy imports, energy, machine capacity and delivery of recovered stock. Pressure-composite production and advanced semiconductor production remain imported.
The 2.5% crater site quota is the eventual programme ceiling. Its architectural population is not a demographic target. The initial vacuum quota and uncounted lava-tube quota remain separate.
No scenario establishes permitted source reserves or a terraforming date. No indefinite exponential growth or free autonomous self-reproduction is assumed.

valuation.status: An illustrative price convention for inherited civic services only, not an estimated exchange rate or a conversion of entire old budgets.

evidence: Inherited engineering scenario inputs, frozen separately from the former population-proportional architecture. Component partitions, source grades and trajectories are unqualified designs.

assumption_status.economics: Scenario procurement rates and engineering allowances, not quotes or validated forecasts. Low launch prices require sustained high flight rate. No automatic productivity reduction is inferred from inflation.
assumption_status.engineering: Chemical rockets, modular mineral processing, solar power and cryogenic storage use known physical mechanisms. Autonomous maintenance, industrial scale, large pressure materials and GW beaming require qualification.
assumption_status.local_fleet_fabrication: Separate design comparison: 70 percent of tug structural mass made from source metals after a 5 percent Earth-built seed, giving 66.5 percent locally made across the fleet; dry-to-payload ratio increases from 0.10 to 0.12. Earth supplies engines, electronics, specialty joints and alloyants. Aggregate 8 percent recoverable-metal grade and 60 percent recovery are unqualified source assumptions. No pressure-composite or semiconductor self-replication is inferred.
assumption_status.propellant: Near-stoichiometric water-derived H2/O2 avoids an indefinite oxygen-surplus inventory. 430 s at mixture near 8 is a design assumption, with 450 and 390 s bounds; chamber cooling and reusable life need qualification. Air oxygen is taken from the same electrolysis stream, making lander mixture slightly hydrogen-rich. Earth launch is a purchased methalox service with a separate gross resource screen.
assumption_status.renewal: Additional physical replacement account: roads 40 years, other bulk 80, metals 50, 95 percent end-to-end recovered mass. This adds missing supplier throughput without rewriting earlier U maintenance accounts.
assumption_status.source: Bennu measurements illustrate possible chemistry only; mining targets must be ordinary, independently surveyed and cleared. Water yield, extractability and energetically accessible inventory are assumptions.
assumption_status.startup: Eight-year qualification/source bootstrap, five-year linear ramp, 20 equivalent years of stock delivery, then two-year final commissioning. Parallel site qualification assumed; no completion in 2041.

industrial.boundary: Conditional owned supply system and material procurement. Prior settlement designs unchanged. No source/deposit, orbit, flight rate or technology is qualified. USD are 2026 real purchasing power inflated once to 2041.

electric_tug_comparison.rule: Water electric propulsion comparison, not part of the budget. Lab precedents do not qualify these efficiencies, MW power or lifetime.

reading_rule: Prices are USD2026 unless named USD2041. Convert once using normalization. Original architecture is a coefficient/control source, never a population multiplier.

boundary.net_definition: Consolidated off-Earth external operating cash balance, then balance after external equipment renewal and a resource-transition provision; debt separate. Internal payments cancel.

revenue.evidence: Conditional full-occupation market and external-purchase scenarios; no customer contracts, market-clearing exchange rate, resource rights or certified reserves.

normalization.basis: Pioneer destination spending gives 31.16 USD2041/U at the reference price; original pressure-component procurement gives 25.32. Manufacturing delivery scope was unpriced in the older U study, so its inferred basket is only a separately labelled illustration.
normalization.status: Proposal only; no currency peg adopted.

propellant_customers.buyers: Independently funded Earth mission customers; excludes all own fleet, settlement growth and intra-system demand.

resources.rule: Specified usable-feed pools are conditional planning quantities, not approved fractions of the catalogue or reserve discoveries.

rules: Receipts from Earth require independent external buyers; internal supplier sales, residents spending U, taxes, borrowing and equity are not additional consolidated earned revenue.
Operating balance is the external cash position of the whole modeled society, not corporate profit or GDP. Domestic wages and retained domestic replacement work are internal.
New commercial facilities and ordinary imported materials are explicit. Existing post-construction capacity may be used only within rated throughput, preserving the separate 25 percent spare margin.
Manufacturing and computing activities are suppressed if their incremental external costs, renewal and resource provision exceed receipts; rejected demand cases remain visible.
The Earth-return service fee covers ground recovery/handling only. Capsules, shields, deorbit fuel and relaunch are priced separately once.
No return spacecraft is assumed empty or to brake for free; outward cargo, fuel backhaul and sale goods share the stated mass and tank limits.
USD inputs are prospective 2026-purchasing-power prices, inflated once; no future vendor quote or million-year economic forecast is asserted.

The proposed 30 USD2041/U normalization is checked against matched destination-service and original pressure-procurement prices. Manufacturing-price comparison is separately hypothetical because the earlier 50 U/kg quote left freight scope unpriced. No currency peg or universal price consistency is adopted.
Resource-transition provision is a stated funding requirement, not a validated depletion valuation or demonstration of adequate million-year sustainability.
Passenger access fares and any unmodelled passenger-carrier surplus are excluded; destination facilities have additional food/life-support provision.
Beyond-local Solar System expansion and its socioeconomic boundary remain unresolved future work.

visitors.U_basis: Pioneer destination-service price from the existing early-export study; no access fare or gravity-productivity premium.

transport.evidence: Comparative engineering scenarios with the same settlement demand; no trajectory-qualified fleet, permitted source reserve or adopted architecture.
rules: Original industrial results remain unchanged; Earth launch flow is conditional on architecture.
All chemical Earth-return braking is propulsive; no aerocapture, free braking or propellant at LEO without delivery.

Electric efficiency is from stored water and electrical bus to exhaust kinetic energy, including feed processing and all gas use; current oxygen-anode specific impulse is not a demonstrated total-water specific impulse.
All new fleet modules are Earth-manufactured in this comparison; the earlier source-structure localization case remains independent.

Additional route inventories are filled from the source network and enter construction material flows; a 2 percent first-dispatch Earth-fuel seed is an explicit bootstrap allowance, not continuing Earth propellant procurement.
Quarter-year depot inventories, 25 percent installed spare margin and 80 percent fleet availability are separate allowances.
Core city/town geometry, population, source protections and ordinary material demand remain fixed.
